author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Keyshape changed to SQUARE. Body is an r4 rounded rectangle (6,18)-(42,42); handle is a smooth semicircular r10 arch about (24,16) whose legs land on the body top at x=14/34 (shared split points). A narrower r8 handle was tried first and read like a padlock shackle, so the wider arch was kept. Lucide handbag/shopping-bag informed the arch-on-box construction.
omissions: Slight trapezoid taper of the reference body dropped per feedback asking for a rounded rectangle.
